One of these burglars was a notorious yeggman who had robbed many post offices and had various indictments pending against him. Wheeler, who is now a laborer under the same office, has a commendable military record to his credit, and recently in the line and the proper performance of his present duties suffered an injury to his left hand which has appreciably and permanently impaired his usefulness in doing the heavier work required of the laborer force.

He alleged at the time that his selection
